title: Core realization from stagewise overlap comparison data
statement: Given the fixed overlap geometry and a family of prescribed comparison data at every stage, the canonical stage and apex equivalences admit coherent transition, base-change and object-pin data forming a PerfectHomObjectRealizationCore.

source.place: Tag 09RE, restriction and derived pullback composition comparisons in the first paragraph of the proof.

proof.text: Substitute the canonical comparison-family equality. Define the finite-stage, apex, and transition base-change arrows. Cocone naturality and baseChangeMap_comp give gk ≫ fk = gj. The two cartesian projection equations prove that their restricted overlap maps obey the component square equation.

Construct the stage and apex object isomorphisms by perfectOverlapStageObjectIso and perfectOverlapApexObjectIso. Set transition to derived pullback along the overlapLimitArrow base change and baseComparison to perfectHomComparison. The defining perfectHomMap conjugation equation proves transition_pin.

Construct comparison with perfectOverlapNaturalComparisonOfSquare using the component square. Cache the four explicitly constructed comparison families through a proved equality interface. Apply the canonical composite object-pin identity to each stage and Boolean branch, then assemble the seven fields into PerfectHomObjectRealizationCore in a private theorem with scheme maps as parameters. Instantiate that construction with the base-change schemes. All fields except this component identity are constructed and checked in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Restriction and composition comparisons in the first proof paragraph.

    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))

    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k) :
    perfectOverlapCoreOfDataStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage
